summary: This joint resolution blocks the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025 (D.C. Act 26-217) from taking effect by disapproving the D.C. Council's December 2025 action under the Home Rule Act.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a congressional disapproval of a D.C. tax conformity and revision act. It addresses taxation policy exclusively and contains no provisions, authorizations, or implications related to government spending levels or appropriations.

The resolution directly blocks implementation of the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025. While this affects D.C. tax policy by preserving the status quo, the bill text provides no information on whether the blocked D.C. changes would have raised or lowered taxes, so the legislation does not push in either direction on the defined scale.
No provisions in the bill relate to healthcare policy, coverage, funding, or regulation.
